title: Ph.D. Program
field: Computer science (machine learning, theory, and related areas)
about: TTIC's PhD program in computer science accepts applications between October 7 and January 15. Applications received by December 9 get full consideration, with decisions expected by March 1. There is no application fee.
requirements: Applications are only accepted between October 7 and January 15
Only complete applications (including at least two reference letters) received by January 15 are considered
